name: Coating Material
description: Production rate adjustment based on the coating material being applied. Waterbased finish (latex/acrylic) is the baseline. Primer is ~20% slower than finish (rate x 0.8). Oil-based coatings are ~15% slower than waterbased equivalents (rate x 0.85). The OB_PRIMER factor combines both penalties (1.25 x 1.176 = ~1.47 = rate x 0.68). Clear and sealer coats run ~10% faster than paint when brushed (thinner liquid, lighter laydown), but spray rates are unaffected because the sprayer doesn't care what's in the cup — so clear/sealer split into BRUSH (0.9) and SPRAY (1.0) variants. Material is auto-derived from substrate_state and coat_number for prime/finish flows; door clear/sealer modules carry an explicit per-task material_type via task_ref shallow merge. Stored as a TIME multiplier per engine convention (>=1 = slower; <1 = faster).
